1604 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year unless divisible by 400, 1604 is not a century year).  
254 days from 03-18:  
Days left in March: 31 - 18 = 13 → 254 - 13 = 241 left.  
April (30): 241 - 30 = 211.  
May (31): 211 - 31 = 180.  
June (30): 180 - 30 = 150.  
July (31): 150 - 31 = 119.  
August (31): 119 - 31 = 88.  
September (30): 88 - 30 = 58.  
October (31): 58 - 31 = 27.  
November has 30 days, so 27 days into November is 27th.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1604-11-27
